question: Will Bitcoin's Coinbase BTC-USD price be above $80,000 at 00:00 UTC on Dec 31, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase is strictly above $80,000 at 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z, observed strictly after 2026-11-11T13:48:40.711Z and at or before 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase is at or below $80,000 at 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z, observed strictly after 2026-11-11T13:48:40.711Z and at or before 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z.
